name: Fort and Shalamar Gardens in Lahore
description: In Lahore, Pakistan, two grand Mughal creations from the reign of Shah Jahan stand together on this listing. The Lahore Fort holds marble palaces and mosques decorated with mosaic and gilding. The Shalamar Gardens, begun in 1641 and finished a year later, step down three terraces of lodges, waterfalls and broad ornamental pools.
